settings.recovery_rule: cooldown - attack_preparation; same rule for player and bot

balance.rationale: Le bonus maximal est atteint a 18 m dans la portee visible et des couloirs normaux. Le DPS de contact reste inferieur au Blaster rapide; le Shotgun conserve son avantage de proximite.
balance.theory_conditions: Cycle initial zero, tous les tirs touchent, sans modules, passifs, soins ou upgrades; ajouter la preparation et le trajet du premier tir. Ces valeurs sont calculees, pas des chronometrages de parties.

model.animations: procedural aim and short skeletal kick with return; no embedded GLB animations
model.lighting: emissive cyan energy cores; no additional dynamic lights

behavior.damage_origin: distance accumulated by the projectile from the real muzzle to the exact impact surface, independent of the shooter
behavior.collision: continuous sphere sweep, initial overlap query, first contact refinement, single finished signal and single damage instance
behavior.muzzle_guard: sphere sweep from torso support to real muzzle; blocked shot resolves at distance zero without relocating muzzle origin
behavior.progression: only successful emission advances cycle, including misses and walls; no expiry
behavior.inputs: existing attack press/hold/release and existing weapon switch; no charge, zoom or additional command
behavior.hud: four segments and enhanced-ready label inside the existing customizable player_vitals widget; readout and weapon core use real instance state
behavior.network: host decides enhanced rank and damage; snapshots synchronize cycle and remaining recovery; reliable visual events never advance cycle
behavior.survival: weapon selection, power and tempo upgrades; upgrades preserve cycle and do not add Blaster effects
behavior.bot: own cycle and projectiles, actual muzzle, LONGSHOT preset and preferred distance around 16-18.5 m

modified_or_added_files.generated_companions: Godot .uid and .import files accompany the new scripts and assets. Existing unrelated and concurrent Mekatana changes were preserved.

dedicated_tests.scope: real player emission, damage and flight, shooter/cible relocation, ranks 5/10/15, misses/walls, refusals/cancellation, lifecycle, PC/mobile input, eight moving aim directions, recoil, Survival upgrades
continuous sphere, thin walls at low physics frequency, enhanced grazing, contained overlap, muzzle guard, multiple colliders, common range and magnetic Area3D
independent bot cycle, real GLB muzzle, damage distance, lifecycle, cancelled actions, swap recovery, in-flight swap and preset
host authority, hostile enhanced flags ignored, refused recovery, snapshot reconciliation, late visual event, cancellation and reset
real OpenGL rendering, eight running directions, muzzle axis, hand grip, recoil recovery and visible diameters

preexisting_failed_check.reason: Blaster left hand misses reachable grip (0.01026904 m vs 0.001 m threshold)
preexisting_failed_check.baseline: Exact same test and same values with rig and aim modifier extracted from Git HEAD in ignored .godot/longshot-baseline. No production baseline or test tolerance modified.

verification.environment_notes: Initial sandbox runs could not write GD-Sync user data/read Windows certificate store. Final dedicated player, bot and network runs used normal user cache access and had no such errors. Some older regression/startup scripts still emit ObjectDB/resource cleanup warnings at process shutdown.

remaining_manual_checks: Comfort, sound level and shot readability on a physical Android device/small screen
Two real network peers under latency, including local predicted effects before host confirmation
Playtest balance against human players; theoretical TTK does not include dodges, modules or cover
